title: Cutoff Picker
summary: Counts down to a store's order cutoff in store time with the shopper's time beside it, so an order doesn't land on a different day than expected.
description: Counts down to the cutoff in store time with the shopper's time beside it, names skipped holidays and closed days, says when the store's date differs, and never moves a chosen date silently: a passed cutoff is announced with the new earliest date one tap away.
catches: Store time zone differing from the shopper's (including a different calendar date)
Holidays and closed days the delivery date skips
A cutoff that passes while the shopper is still choosing
Time needed to finish checkout before the cutoff (checkoutMinutes)
limits: The cutoff, holidays and closed days come from your props
Uses the visitor's clock unless you pass `now`; a wrong device clock skews the countdown
a11y: Dates are keyboard-navigable with arrow keys
The countdown is a role="img" with an aria-label; the animated digits are aria-hidden
Changes are announced in a role="status" region
server: Re-check the cutoff on the server at order time and reject or reschedule dates that are no longer available.
